name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=resource, descriptor=portrait_cache_buffer_used). Accurately describes role: running byte-offset write cursor (used bytes) into the portrait sprite cache buffer. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix). Reflects scalar/counter data type. Live Ghidra name matches byte-identical.
purpose: Running write cursor into the portrait sprite cache buffer (data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache @ 0x53A61): the byte offset of the end of the packed sprite payload, i.e. where the next appended portrait's sprite bytes start.
logic_summary: Zero at startup via the CRT BSS-zero loop; the runtime value is seeded on the first-time cache fill before any append read, so the initializer is never relied on at runtime. Sole accessor is fd2_load_portrait_to_cache: first-time init store at 0x1110b sets it to data_size+0x780 (0x780 = head frame-offset lookup table size); append path uses it as the fread destination offset (0x1115f: cache_base+used), as the per-frame offset base (0x11178), and advances it by data_size after each append (0x1119c). Single 32-bit dword scalar; always a non-negative buffer byte-offset.
element_semantics: Scalar byte-offset (write cursor) into the 0x32A00-byte portrait sprite cache buffer; value = end-of-packed-payload offset = next-append start. Initial first-time value is data_size+0x780; grows by each loaded portrait's sprite-data size.
notes: Disassembly of fd2_load_portrait_to_cache @ 0x11019 verifies every cited access byte-precise: 0x1110b WRITE (MOV [0x539EC],EAX = [ESP+0x34]+EDI where EDI=0x780), 0x1115f READ (ADD EAX,[0x539EC]), 0x11178 READ (MOV EBX,[0x539EC]), 0x1119c READ_WRITE (ADD [0x539EC],EAX). Memory content all-zero (BSS). _cstart_ @ 0x3cb65 WRITE + 0x3cb57 DATA = CRT BSS-zero loop init; __FiniRtns @ 0x45de6 DATA = section/range boundary marker. Game-side writer present (fd2_load_portrait_to_cache) -> not const. Ghidra typed undefined4, consistent with uint32. fd2_load_chapter_battle_data resets portrait_cache_count to 0 without resetting buffer_used, but the count==0 first-time path reseeds buffer_used before use, so no stale-value bug. Ghidra data plate was empty (null) -> created via PLATE_COMMENT. src comment block (rsrc.c lines 822-845) already precise/verified -> kept.
